title: ui.tile 1.0
description: ui::Tile (experimental): one tile on the home screen, the career content picker, the F1 World screen or a car category picker. A press opens route; gate limits where it shows.

place.description: The screen the tile is on.

title.description: The tile's text: a lang key or { "literal" }.

image.description: The slice the tile shows: a ui.texture_slice record id (<addon>/<key>) or a #array[name] string. A slice no enabled record provides is logged, and the tile shows without an image.

route.description: The route a press opens: a ui.route record id (<addon>/<key>) or bare key, or a stock route name. The core passes the game the record's key, the name of the route group the build cloned; a bare key or a stock name passes unchanged. An id no enabled record has is logged and passed as written.

gate.description: Where the record applies: one selector (an object) or a list of selectors that must all match (docs/std/layers.md); empty or null: everywhere.

extends.description: Data files only: this record is a variant of that record, and its value is a merge patch on the base.
